common.sandbox_hint: Test mode: no real money, bank or messages are used.
common.offline: You are offline. Your work is saved and will send when the network returns.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

welcome.title: Namaste! Welcome
welcome.intro: Prove your business is real, and show it to a lender, with your phone.

never.title: What we never do
never.share: We never share without your yes.
never.train: We never use your data to train AI without separate permission.
never.delete: You can delete everything at any time.

login.title: Log in with your phone
login.otp: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your phone
login.set_pin_why: Family members often share a phone. Your PIN keeps your passport yours.
login.new_device: New phone noticed. For your safety, sharing is paused for 24 hours.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.no_hint: Without your yes we cannot build a passport. You can come back any time.

interview.title: Tell us about your business
interview.q_since: Since which year is the business running?
interview.not_understood: I did not understand. Please say it again, or tap a choice.
interview.ids_hint: A business without either is still welcome.
interview.women_owned: This business is run by a woman

home.title: My business
home.no_business: Let us set up your business.
home.needs_voice: {{count}} page(s) could not be read. Read them aloud.
home.presence_today: Shop photo for today (asked by us)
home.presence_why: On a few random days we will ask for a shop photo with location. It proves your shop is real and open.

capture.hint_ledger_page: Hold the phone straight over one page, in good light.
capture.hint_shop_front: Stand outside so the shop board is visible.
capture.hint_presence: Take a photo of your shop now. We ask on random days to check the shop is open.
capture.hint_bill: Hold the bill flat in good light.
capture.why_camera: We use the live camera only, not old photos, so nobody can send someone else's picture.
capture.no_camera: Camera is not available. Please allow camera access.
capture.blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and try again.
capture.too_dark: It is too dark. Move to more light.
capture.too_bright: Too much light. Move out of direct sun.
capture.glare: There is a shine on the page. Tilt the phone a little.
capture.saved: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when there is network.

readback.title: Check these entries
readback.intro: Listen and say if each entry is right.
readback.reason_low_confidence: We were not sure we read this right.
readback.reason_page_total: This page's total does not match its entries.
readback.correct_amount: Say or tap the right amount
readback.not_mine: This is not in my ledger

voice_entry.title: Read your ledger aloud
voice_entry.intro: Say one entry at a time, like: Sharma ji se chaar hazaar mile, 12 October.
voice_entry.buttons_mode: Let us use big buttons instead.

import.title: Add a ledger app export
import.intro: In Khatabook, OkCredit or Vyapar, export your entries as a CSV file, then pick it here.

statement.title: Add a bank or UPI statement
statement.intro: Download the PDF statement from your bank or UPI app, then pick it here. Linking your bank directly is stronger: a PDF alone can reach at most band C.

aa.title: Link your bank
aa.why: Your bank sends 12 months of payments straight to us, through Account Aggregator. Nobody can edit it, so it is the strongest proof.
aa.monthly: Refresh every month so the passport stays fresh
aa.sandbox_hint: In real use, your AA app opens here. In Sandbox, approve or reject below.
aa.rejected: You said no. Nothing was shared.

recon.title: Are these the same person?
recon.intro: Your ledger name and the bank name look different. Tell us if they are the same.
recon.done: Thank you. {{rate}}% of your ledger now matches your bank payments.

partners.title: Ask your trading partners
partners.intro: We picked your top partners from your payments. You cannot change this list. Enter each one's phone number and we will ask them to confirm.
partners.none: Add bank data first. We pick partners from your payments.

confirm.title: Confirm a trading partner
confirm.step_pay: To prove this is your account, pay ₹1 from the UPI account they trade with ({{masked}}). We refund it.
confirm.sandbox_pay: Sandbox: pretend to pay from this UPI ID
confirm.pending: We have not received the ₹1 yet.
confirm.proven: Thank you! Your account is confirmed.
confirm.rejected: The ₹1 came from a different account than the one in their payments, so we cannot accept this confirmation.
confirm.not_valid: This link is not valid any more.

claim.intro: Four quick questions. Pick the closest answer.
claim.id_optional: Your GSTIN or Udyam (optional, makes your word count more)
claim.done: Thank you. Your confirmation is signed and saved.
claim.discrepancy: Thank you. Your answer did not match the payments we see, so it counts for less.
claim.not_guarantor: You are not a guarantor. But false confirmations lower the weight of all your confirmations.

passport.title: My Trust Passport
passport.scan: A lender scans this to check it is real
passport.not_credit: This is proof of your business, not a loan. The lender decides.
passport.none: You do not have a passport yet.
